Methylene blue may increase serotonin due to its inhibition of monoamine oxidase A (MAO-A). If methylene blue administration is necessary, serotonergic drugs should be discontinued immediately, and the patient should be monitored for central nervous system (CNS) toxicity. Serotonergic therapy can be resumed 24 hours after the last dose of methylene blue or after two weeks of monitoring, whichever occurs first.
